question: Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is the option no 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the line and other words given in the options.
 
 
• It was a lovely place, with green trees, brightly (5) ________ birds, and cool running streams
 
• In this line, the word **"Brightly" **is working as an **Adverb.**
 
• It is modifying noun "Colour"
 
• Birds is plural Noun form and the word "Coloured" is working as an past Participle (adjective)
 
• So we need the past participle form which will modify noun (Bird).
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option no 4. The complete sentence is "**It was a lovely place, with green trees, brightly coloured birds, and cool running streams.**
